name: Loop of 2 hours from Huaröd without a spur to a favourite
description: Four made-up favourites around a start by Huaröd (random roads, not rated by anyone). A loop's waypoint lands in the middle of the epic one on road 1096 by Skartofta, 2 km before its road's next junction: the next leg used to ride on to that junction, turn and come all the way back, a 2 km out-and-back along the favourite (found on a real ride of the same kind, 2026-09-29). The way to a guide and back is cut however far it goes, so no loop has a side loop outside its home zone.
